model_annotation: Figure 10 illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis displays language families, including II-Balto-Slavic, II-Germanic, II-Indoic, II-Romance, II-Slavic, II-other, Semitic, Uralic, and Isolate, presented in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," exhibits a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at increments of 2.  Each language family is represented by a group of three bars, each of a different color: teal, orange, and light blue, with labels "roBERT-L," "mBERT-R," and "mBERT-B" respectively. The teal "roBERT-L" bars appear consistently shorter than the orange "mBERT-R" bars across all language families. The shortest bar, corresponding to "roBERT-L" for the Isolate family, has an approximate value of 2, while the tallest bar, "mBERT-B" for the II-Romance family, has an approximate value of 28. Error bars are displayed above each bar, indicating the standard deviation. The bars appear to be sorted by language family, and no particular bars are visually emphasized beyond their different colors.
